children: Palm oil (FCPOc3) may rise into a range of 5,032 ringgit to 5,083 ringgit per metric ton, as it has almost recovered from a drop to the August 28 low of 4,799 ringgit.
The recovery suggests a continuation of the uptrend from 4,462 ringgit. The trend has been developing within a rising channel, which indicates an aggressive target of 5,166 ringgit.
A realistic target is 5,083 ringgit, the 176.4% projection level of the uptrend from 4,462 ringgit. A break below 4,949 ringgit may trigger a fall to 4,897 ringgit.
On the hourly chart, the market may revisit its August 21 high of 5,031 ringgit, as it has briefly pierced above 5,006 ringgit, a 7% retracement.
A bullish flag seems to be forming. It will be confirmed when the contract breaks 5,006 ringgit. The pattern suggests a target around 5,130 ringgit.
